answer_1.quote: In recent years, state-of-the-art language models (LMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of benchmarks, often rivaling human capabilities in tasks such as translation, summarization, and question-answering ... We evaluate on Alpaca, Code-Alpaca and Aleatoric-List datasets.

answer_2.quote: We measure semantic similarity using E5 mistral-7b, Jaccard similarity on token sets, and all-mpnet-base-v2; stylistic consistency is evaluated via automatic classification with GPT-4o mini.

answer_3.quote: We generate semantically equivalent prompt variations using gpt-4o mini and classify stylistic dimensions of responses also with gpt-4o mini via zero‑shot classification prompts.
methods: semantic similarity scoring using embedding model
criteria: stylistic dimensions (code snippet presence, bullet format, etc.)
